procedure do_updates is
 --
 -- I am only checking for components which do not have a
 -- manufacturing time interdiction; If it already has, then it
 -- can never be removed because the collection date may only be
 -- moved to an older date (not a later date)
 --
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_first_sep_time date;
 temp_second_sep_time date;
 temp_third_sep_time date;
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn VARCHAR2(10);
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct valid_products.product_code,
 product_type, time_limit
 from components, valid_products
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 components.product_code = valid_products.product_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and
 not exists
 (select 'x'
 from component_interdictions
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 components.product_code =
 component_interdictions.product_code and
 inter_code = 'CMTI');
begin

 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, old_coll_date,
 insert_dats, change_user_id)

 (:unit_id, :new_coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :coll_date, sysdate, :banner.user_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then

 check_package_failure;

 IF :GLOBAL.first_time = 'Y' THEN
 begin
 update units

 (trunc(:coll_date)-trunc(:new_coll_date)),

 --
 begin

 /*

 Code128 modification. Added by HCL consulting on 23rd May 1997 
 */

 end;
 --

 /***** End of added patch for missing tables ...... HCL *****/

 if :GLOBAL.first_time = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 begin
 select bleed_start_time, first_sep_time,
 second_sep_time, third_sep_time
 into temp_bleed_start_time, temp_first_sep_time,
 temp_second_sep_time, temp_third_sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :new_coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('j');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 if c1_rec.time_limit is not null
 then
 if c1_rec.product_type
 in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 end if;
 if c1_rec.product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 end if;
 if c1_rec.product_type in ('FFP','RPFF','DUFFP','DURPF')
 then
 begin
 select ffp_freeze_durn
 into temp_ffp_freeze_durn
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting
 ffp_freeze_time for chapter');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;
 if temp_second_sep_time is not null
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 end if;
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_ffp_freeze_durn),'009.99');
 if temp_time_difference is not null
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,1,3))+
 to_number(substr(temp_ffp_freeze_durn,2,3))
 )||'.'||
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,5,2))+
 to_number(substr(temp_ffp_freeze_durn,6,2))
 );
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_time_difference),'009.99');
 if to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,6,2))
 >= 60
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,2,3))+1)
 ||'.'||
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,6,2))-60);
 end if;
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_time_difference),'009.99');
 end if;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'N';
 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other error
 message('Erroneous time difference');
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 else
 temp_time_difference := ltrim(temp_time_difference);
 temp_time_difference :=
 substr(temp_time_difference,1,3)||'.'||
 to_char(round(to_number(
 substr(temp_time_difference,5,2))*100/60));
 if to_number(temp_time_difference)>c1_rec.time_limit
 then
 :GLOBAL.time_interdiction := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.time_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val:= sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id,
 :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 c1_rec.product_code,
 'CMTI',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message
 ('Interdiction CMTI not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 end if;
end;
